reuse_factor: Anchor economics are one A-pack per call reused across all output-column CTAs; the candidate must preserve one-pack-per-call economics rather than relocating quantization into every output-column CTA.
duplication_factor: Must remain 1x versus the anchor; if any prototype quantizes A independently inside each output-column CTA, effective duplication becomes 128x for n4096 or 90x for n2880, and the card fails immediately.
saved_global_bytes_per_block: Do not bank this as a win until the ownership law is proven; the provisional lower bound is deleting the external 8704 B A-temp bridge per call (a_packed + a_scale) plus the matching reload path, but fewer launches alone is not a valid win claim.
why_total_quant_work_drops: The branch is only valid if it removes the external helper/temp bridge without reintroducing full A quantization inside each output-column CTA; otherwise total quant work rises and the lane is a disguised fused-A reopen.
kill_criteria: If runtime b_shuffle is not layout-compatible with _get_b_preshuffled_mfma_fp4(b_q), immediately downgrade the lane to m32_singlelaunch_rawb_nodup_apack_k512.

vetoes: Do not touch other exact shapes in the first pass.
